subject: FOCUS DECISION: security-state authorization for cached/frozen visuals
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-security-rd-visual-security-authorization-20261002. Discovery scored security-state visual authorization highest (29). Current main retains SnapshotCache frames for 15 minutes, can bridge them before fresh capture, and secure capture failures can leave that stale bridge visible; no keyguard/device-lock epoch or presentation fence exists. This is an authorization boundary distinct from semantic freshness: after lock/keyguard/security context changes, old pixels must be ineligible even if exact-cycle/age/geometry checks pass. Live board recheck excluded newly claimed visual-phase, hinge-ingress, semantic-reclose, and interaction-coherence workstreams plus historic frame-provenance/perf work. Cheapest decisive action: exact security-epoch model + adversarial stale-callback tests; no production writes.
